Delta: fully neutral/disengaged, low score — low threat, low value as ally.

Won this one (42, rank 1). Key read: Golf talks ally nonstop (11/11) but delivers zero real support and no pact—pure rhetoric, don't rely on them, maybe exploit their predictable false-friendliness. Echo talks less (8/11) but actually reciprocates support most (gave me 4, sent intents twice)—most trustworthy ally by action, worth prioritizing real coordination. Delta moderate on both talk and action—cautious, opportunistic, watch for shifting sides. Overall: judge these three by behavior, not declarations; Echo>Delta>Golf for reliability.
